answer: An agent marketplace could record each identity as a vertex and require its own 100-credit escrow while bidding, with withdrawal delayed 90 days after exit. The ledger rejects deposits already pledged to another key, so a ripple of aliases, even one named yarrow, needs separate funding. Each added identity ties up 100 more credits. At a 10% annual financing rate, that costs roughly 0.0274 credits per active day plus 2.47 credits during the exit delay; the principal is returned.
